text: Deadlines are a part of life, but they don't have to be stressful. The key is good time management, which starts with planning. Break your work into smaller steps and schedule them on a calendar. Next, practice prioritization. Not all tasks are equally important, so focus on what is urgent and has the biggest impact first. It is also crucial to manage the scope of your project. If you keep adding new features or ideas, you will miss your deadline. Be realistic about what can be finished. Finally, remember communication. If you see a problem, tell your team or client early. They can often help you adjust the plan, rather than being surprised by a late delivery.
